text:
maya: infra-oncall-bot flagged NA-SOUTH1: heartbeat flaps on provisioner, nodes getting marked unhealthy and draining. Seeing gen latency spike for na-south1. Anyone oncall?
infra-oncall-bot: ALERT: node-provisioner(na-south1) heartbeat failures >5m. auto-mark-unhealthy triggered.
aj: I see request queues backing up, continuous-batcher p95 up ~400ms. Is this a batching window regression or routing bottleneck?
danny: Provisioner is throttling attach requests after heartbeat misses. GPUs not completing attach -> capacity drops.
maya: Traffic shift started to na-west/na-east but available headroom here is limited. I'm going to trigger emergency spill to dedicated pools.
nate: Do we have approval to spin dedicated? That will use reserved credits + drive cost.
aj: Do it — customers are seeing SLO breaks. Also, bypass prefix cache for affected routes to avoid kv-layer lock contention.
danny: Running repair command: `./infractl repair-heartbeat --region na-south1 --force` now.
infra-oncall-bot: Command executed by danny: repair job started on 8 hosts. Logs: https://internal/logs/repair/1958123456
maya: Observing KV-layer queueing: `kv-layer/pool=fast` queue depth x6. Forcing small-batch mode: `export SPAWN_BATCHER_PROMOTE=small` on affected sidecars.
aj: Pushing runtime hotfix to reduce batching window 40ms -> 10ms. Will canary to na-west first.
nate: Monitoring shows latency on affected routes dropped ~120ms after small-batch flip, but CPU on dedicated nodes spiked ~25%. Watching.
danny: Still seeing failing heartbeats from rack-7. Ops on site are checking power chain and NICs.
maya: If rack-7 doesn't recover in 10m we'll evict allocations and add routing exclusion for that rack.
aj: :thumbsup: Keep the traffic shift in place; start graceful drain of na-south1 rather than hard cutover. Also notify CS and sales.
cs-alerts: Notified: "NA-SOUTH1 degraded: generation latency elevated; partial traffic failover in progress. Working on mitigations."
sre-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: status=mitigating, impact=partial, next_update=15m
danny: Repair finished on 8 hosts, 2 still flapping. Kicked ops ticket INC-7891 for onsite power-cycle of rack-7 nodes.
maya: Keeping small-batch mode for a 30m stability window. Will revert once tail latencies look good for two consecutive 5m intervals.
aj: If latency regresses we'll roll routing back and enable quantized model variant to reduce CPU and throughput pressure.
maya: Thanks team, standing down to monitoring. I'll post a full summary after the 30m window.
